# FG-LLM-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_rerun_of_a_closed_or_off_merge_request_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI の一次レビューはやり直せません（この MR が開いていないか、プロジェクトで AI の一次レビューを使っていません）。
- en: The AI first-pass review cannot be run again (this merge request is not open, or the project does not use the AI first pass).
- id: Tinjauan awal AI tidak dapat dijalankan lagi (merge request ini tidak terbuka, atau proyek tidak memakai tinjauan awal AI).

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §8.2: `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/ai-review/rerun` (`AiReviewRerun`, a Developer and above, a person) was allowed by authorize() but the merge request or the project cannot be reviewed again, read under the merge request's row lock: `reason=not_open` (closed or merged: the worker reviews open merge requests only), `reason=review_off` (the project's `llm.review` is `off`: there is no first pass to repeat; a Maintainer turns it on in the project settings), `reason=no_head` (nothing was pushed yet). Nothing was written and the rerun was not counted against the limit of 3 an hour (FG-WEB-0010 `route=ai_review_rerun`).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The answer's request_id finds `forge.request.failed` with `error_code=FG-LLM-0008`, `reason`, `project_id` and `iid`. Read the state: SELECT state, head_sha FROM forge.merge_requests WHERE project_id = <id> AND iid = <iid>; SELECT review FROM forge.project_llm WHERE project_id = <id> (no row = off). The reruns asked so far: SELECT head_sha, requested_by, requested_at FROM forge.llm_review_reruns WHERE merge_request_id = <mr id> ORDER BY id DESC.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing is broken. `review_off`: a Maintainer sets llm.review to advisory or required (project settings, a web session) if the project should use the first pass. `not_open`: reopen the merge request first. `no_head`: push the branch.
